description: This file defines the SessionActorQueue class, which manages a queue of asynchronous tasks associated with session actors. It provides methods for retrieving tail maps for testing, counting total pending tasks, getting pending counts for specific sessions, and running asynchronous operations queued per session key.

classes.name: SessionActorQueue
classes.description: A class that manages per-session asynchronous task queues, allowing controlled execution and tracking of pending operations.

methods.name: getTailMapForTesting
methods.description: Returns the tail map used internally for testing purposes.

methods.name: getTotalPendingCount
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total number of pending tasks across all sessions.

methods.name: getPendingCountForSession
methods.description: Returns the number of pending tasks for a specific session identified by the actor key.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Enqueues an asynchronous operation associated with an actor key, managing the pending count accordingly.
